Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo and the action items to keep momentum: 

- Decision criteria we heard: 1) predictable per-token economics at scale, 2) private VPC deployment option for sensitive inference, 3) fine-grained auditing / request-level logs for compliance.
- Technical owners: Tom (security/infra) is evaluating deployment/network fit.
- Business/economic owner: need confirmation — is Mark Reynolds (CFO) the right person to finalize TCO and commit to reserve capacity?

Proposed next steps: 
1) We’ll share SOC 2 excerpt + architecture diagram for your security team to review (attached).
2) Draft MPA and indicative pricing for a 12-month committed Dedicated plan (we’ll send a redline-friendly doc).
3) Procurement touchpoint: loop in procurement@heliotech.com for contract logistics — propose timeline below.

Timeline suggestion (flexible):
- 11/30: Security review begins (Tom).
- 12/03: Procurement intro call (procurement + Ben Carter from Redwood).
- 12/10: Pricing/contract decision window (Mark).

Can you confirm: 1) economic buyer (Mark?) and 2) who on your side will lead the procurement thread so we can bring the right folks?

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-soc2-excerpt.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: redwood-architecture-diagram.png (PNG)]

Thanks —

- Economic buyer: Confirmed — Mark Reynolds (CFO) should be part of the pricing conversations. Mark, adding you so you have context from the demo.
- Security lead: Tom will drive the SOC2/architecture review; he may request a short architecture Q&A once he has the diagram.
